fields.Name: Skip ICF - Issues by Type and Status
fields.Description: Support issue mix from MJ_BizApps_Issues: Issues by Issue Type and Issue Status.

InputDefinition.userMessage: How are our support issues distributed by issue type and status? Show it as a chart, and let me click on any type/status combination to see those issues. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of issue counts by issue type and status
Uses MJ_BizApps_Issues: Issues with their Issue Type and Issue Status names (not raw IDs)
Issue types include Data Correction (largest), General, Events and Billing; total is about 103 issues
Statuses include New, In Progress, Resolved and Closed
Clicking a type/status combination shows a table of those issues with number, title, severity and priority
Rows can open the underlying issue record
